_about: Frame loss lessons: the analysis line written to the combat log (LOG > COMBAT) when the player's frame is lost. One lesson per loss. FrameLossReport.gd decides when each applies and their priority; only the wording lives here. Placeholders: {killer} (who did it), {count} (how many attackers), {key:action} (the key bound to an input action, e.g. {key:sweep}). Never say the pilot died.
heat: Heat was cooking your components. Ease off before the heat bar tops out.
flag_ignored: {killer} fired on your Flag. Some pilots do; most let a Flagged frame go.

creature.Coyote: Coyotes hunt by heat and come in packs. A cold mecha is hard for them to find.
creature.Coyote Spitter: Coyote Spitters hang back and lob globs from range. Close the distance or break line of sight.
creature.Fisher: Fishers sleep through heat but wake on noise. Pass them quietly, or stay out of harpoon range.
creature.Stalker: Stalkers hunt in packs and circle to your back. Keep turning to face them.
creature.Brute: Brutes open with a charge. Get out of its line before it lands.
creature.Spitter: Spitters keep their distance and lob acid. Close in, or get behind cover.
creature.Tick Swarm: Ticks jump onto hot mechas and drain their heat. Run cool near a swarm.
creature.Cyst: Cysts hatch guards to defend themselves. Clear the guards before you go for the nest.
creature.default: Creatures hunt mechas too. Learn what draws each one.

unseen: {killer} wasn't on your sensors. A sweep ({key:sweep}) shows what is around before it finds you.
lit: Your illuminator was on when {killer} hit you. A lit mecha is seen through walls; {key:toggle_illuminator} turns it off.
outnumbered: You were fighting {count} at once. Break line of sight and take them one at a time.
no_head: Your head came off, and your sight shrank to almost nothing.
overweight: You were over weight capacity, cargo included, and slow because of it.
shield_flanked: Your shield ({key:shield}) only covers the front. They came at you from the side.
